# ankra_cluster_stack_variables (Data Source)

Reads the variables of one stack on a cluster. While the stack has an unpublished draft, the platform reports the draft's variables. The counterpart of `ankra cluster stacks variables list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_stack_variables" "platform" {
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.production.id
  stack_name = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.
- `stack_name` (String) Name of the stack.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<stack_name>`.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Variable values by name.
